entities.summary: Jordan Norberto Vallenilla is a Dominican former professional baseball pitcher who currently serves as the pitching coach for the Guerreros de Oaxaca of the Mexican League. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Arizona Diamondbacks and Oakland Athletics, and in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chunichi Dragons and Tokyo Yakult Swallows.
